english.title: Fail to arrange and present consignment of animal / animal products and documents at border inspection facility

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 15(1), 39 and 42 of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the person responsible for the consignment of animals / products
after the consignment had been unloaded
failed to arrange
with reasonable expedition
for it to be presented
together with the relevant export health certificate and other documentation specified for that consignment
at the border control inspection facilities
to enable the required checks and control to be carried out as specified in regulation 15 of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

For offence committed between 13/12/19 and 31/12/20 see H20650
